content.text:
Candidate: let each visual component own its animation; share only the motion lifecycle and ranking choreography internally. Caller usage: ```svelte
``` `DeclaredTotals` continues selecting the backend total and formatting the exact decimal string, then supplies ``. FunderSummary uses the same header composition. Types and ownership: ```ts // Metric.svelte changeKey?: string; // Replay incoming value only when committed key changes. // SignedBarList.svelte changeKey?: string; // Replay rows and bars on committed key changes. // Internal motion.svelte.ts, not barrel-exported type MotionTarget = { element: HTMLElement; frames: Keyframe[]; timing: KeyframeAnimationOptions; }; function observeMotion( key: () => string | undefined, targets: () => MotionTarget[], initial: "static" | "animate", ): void; // not implemented // Shared choreography, consumed by RankingList and SignedBarList. function rankingMotion( row: HTMLElement, bar: HTMLElement, index: number, ): MotionTarget[]; // not implemented ``` Lifecycle helper snapshots the initial key on mount, reacts after DOM updates, cancels owned animations before replay, skips motion under reduced preference, cancels immediately when preference changes, and cleans up on destruction. It never controls data or remounts children. Each instance owns its animation handles; no global state or selector registration system. `Metric` renders the formatted string exactly once in a persistent inner span. Animate that span from `translateY(100%)` to `translateY(0)` inside a clipping wrapper. The keyboard-scrollable outer `.member-total` region stays stationary and retains its identity and focus. Do not animate the heading, interpret numeric text, create old/new accessible copies, or turn unavailable text into a scrollable region. Shared ranking choreography owns the observed existing behavior: row opacity 0→1 and translateY(8px)→0 over 300ms, bar scaleX(0)→1 over 420ms, and index ×35ms delay. Preserve current default easing. RankingList opts into initial animation; SignedBarList uses static initial rendering and committed-key replay. SignedBarList owns its geometry: positive transform origin left, negative right, so both expand away from the baseline. RankingList retains its left origin. This requires migrating RankingList’s local CSS animations to the shared choreography in the same change. Otherwise “same as rankings” becomes duplicated constants with two owners. Existing ranking reduced-motion tests currently inspect CSS `animation-name`; replace those implementation-specific assertions with no active animations and final visibility/transform assertions. Layout: - Header uses `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto` and top alignment. - Metric and filter are on the same desktop row immediately after the native view tabs. - Stack at narrow widths with a token gap; filter keeps `align="end"` and its existing wrapping links. - Remove obsolete `.declared-totals { grid-column: 1 / -1; }`, which otherwise forces another full-width row. - Keep arrangement CSS in features; clipping/value animation CSS belongs inside Metric. - Remove the outer ContentChange from MemberSummary so opacity fades do not compound row/bar animation. FunderSummary can retain ContentChange around its body, excluding the header/metric. Do not alter history or rankings feature wrappers merely for consistency. Alternatives: 1. Extend ContentChange with a roll-up variant and wrap Metric externally. Small diff, but moves the heading/focus region and lets generic wrappers animate financial presentation incorrectly; reject. 2. Keep RankingList’s CSS and copy the animations into SignedBarList. Smaller initial patch, but splits the requested shared visual language and makes later drift likely; reject. 3. Key the summary or list on period. Easy replay, but remounts descendants and risks focus/disclosure state; reject. Scope: MemberSummary, FunderSummary, DeclaredTotals, Metric, SignedBarList, RankingList, internal motion helper, obsolete feature CSS, README/COMPOSITION and gallery. No backend, money parsing, or period-state changes. Verification targets: - `periods.spec.ts`: replace the current assertion that metric starts below controls with desktop row overlap and metric-left/filter-right; retain narrow no-overflow and tabs-before-summary checks. - Gallery: initial-static Metric/SignedBarList; exact long formatted value; one accessible value; unchanged focused region; two rapid key changes cancel/replay; live reduced-motion cancellation; negative-origin geometry. - Feature: pending navigation keeps previous value/bars, committed response animates once, failed navigation does not animate, history navigation replays, disclosure remains open. - Rankings: preserve initial entry and stagger behavior, small viewport layout, reduced motion. - Capture desktop member/funder summaries after the final layout change. Concern: availability transitions currently intentionally replace available-region versus unavailable-paragraph branches in Metric. Preserve that existing semantic contract; test focus preservation across available→available updates rather than claiming DOM identity across incompatible semantics.
